simple: Cloud sandbox: opens suspicious files and links in an isolated environment and shows what they do. Files are submitted manually, via API, from response playbooks or automatically — from Endpoint Security Core and Essentials, ZTSA Internet Access, network sensors and Deep Discovery Inspector (each source is licensed separately). Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
